def: {properly, like this, i.e. by implication, (of manner) thus (or so); also (of place) here (or hither); or (of time) now}

occurrences.text: Hitherto is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
